title: Deep learning guides discovery of the STB-C017 kynurenine-pathway inhibitor
summary: Convolutional neural-network models trained on prior IDO and TDO bioactivity guided screening and assay-driven refinement, leading to STB-C017. The study reports dual inhibition in biochemical and cell assays, reduced kynurenine in mice and enhanced antitumor responses when combined with immune-checkpoint inhibitors in mouse models. This entry represents the November 2021 journal version; an earlier 2021 Research Square manuscript concerns the same study, and efficacy or safety in patients is not established.

evidence.tested: Biochemical and cell assays tested IDO/TDO inhibition, followed by mouse studies of kynurenine suppression and antitumor combinations in the originating study.
evidence.unknown: Clinical efficacy and safety are not established; originating-study assays and mouse experiments are not independent replication.
evidence.ai_role: Separate CNN classifiers ranked potential IDO and TDO inhibitors. Four cycles of predictions, selection and measured assays updated the models before lead selection.

source_review.scope: Primary full article Methods, result-specific experiments, discussion, affiliations and journal publication metadata; no independent replication performed.
